summary: An official warning notes that patients taking levodopa by itself must stop it at least twelve hours before starting an extended-release combination of carbidopa and levodopa, and treatment must be personalized to lower side effects [6]. Small computer models, rather than tests on people, gave levodopa low risk scores for both the liver and the heart [M]. Similar drugs carry serious warnings in the United States, including warnings for immune system, blood, and blood vessel problems [3][4][5]. Additionally, one clinical study involving levodopa noted a reason related to new safety information [9].
